{{Short description|City in Ukhdari}}

'''Behidja''' is a city in [[Ukhdari]] in central [[Ayuma]]. Although it had not previously hosted senior international [[Arraby]], the city was selected as one of nine host cities for the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]].

The newly-built Behidja Arena, a 50,200-seat stadium, was inaugurated on 14 February 1760, four months before the opening of the tournament. The Arena staged seven World Cup matches, including the round-of-sixteen fixture between [[Raledria]] and [[Terressin]] on 29 June 1760.
